description: Official BulkPublish MCP server for scheduling, cross-posting, and analyzing social media posts across 15 platforms. Use the hosted remote server with OAuth or run it locally with npx.

notes: The hosted endpoint supports OAuth 2.1 with dynamic client registration and PKCE S256 (scope `bulkpublish`) or an `Authorization: Bearer bp_...` API key. Local stdio requires `BULKPUBLISH_API_KEY`.
Metadata updated from issue #3346 using the package README, project source, MCP docs, and OAuth discovery metadata.
The local full profile exposes 79 tools; the hosted core profile exposes 20 tools, or 27 with the inbox profile.
